segmentation.text: to a vehicle which has entered the intersection
Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4],
this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions,
when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to
or is making a left turn.

elements.justification: The driver of a vehicle: the vehicle aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'); the driver role read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

Approaching an intersection is occupying a carrier whose entrance end is that intersection: rel.occupies on a carrier c (st.travel_region) with st.lane_enters 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end'; 'a road user occupying one such carrier approaches through it whatever its motion'. Not the subject's presence in the intersection, which the obligation reads.

Yielding is not moving into the intersection (drv.motion.moving with rel.occupies of st.intersection) while the precedence of another vehicle is owed; the entry observation, where x's footprint overlaps both c and i, is where it is judged.

A vehicle y (vehicle aggregate) which has entered: y's footprint overlaps i (rel.occupies) and has overlapped it continuously since an observation at which y occupied a carrier cy with st.lane_enters cy i, the carrier it entered from.

From a different highway: y's carrier cy lies on a st.highway ('the entire public way between its boundary lines') (st.on_way 'the public way ... a structure region lies on') that x's approach carrier c does not lie on.

An official traffic-control device (DEF-NRS-484A-145 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... placed or erected by a public authority') that controls an intersection: the words 'intersections controlled by' limit its members to the devices that assign precedence at the junction - dev.traffic_signal 'a signal head', dev.stop_sign 'regulatory sign requiring a full halt', dev.yield_sign 'regulatory sign requiring yielding' - that govern i or a carrier entering it (dev.governs 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls ... or an intersection'). Markings, warning and guide signs control no precedence at the junction and are left out. Official status read from presence.

Vehicles (aggregate) approaching from opposite directions: rel.oncoming's contract says the direction a road user approaches from is 'read through the carrier it approaches through ... and through that carrier's direction (st.lane_direction)'. x's approach carrier c and y's approach carrier cy (each with st.lane_enters into i, y's being the one it entered from) have designated directions (st.lane_direction 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in') whose dot product is below minus p.opposed_approach_cos_tolerance.

Is making a left turn: the vehicle's heading is turning to the left (drv.motion.turning_left, yaw rate to the left above the resolution) while its footprint overlaps the intersection (rel.occupies, st.intersection).

operationalizations.standard: the right-of-way (DEF-NRS-484A-210: 'circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash')
operationalizations.convention: Traffic-conflict technique: the danger of a crash between x and y is a predicted closest approach of their centres, under constant velocities (which carry direction, speed and proximity), within the time-to-collision horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) at a centre distance below the clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance).

intentions.meaning: The road user's current plan includes a left turn at the target region.

applicability: x is a vehicle. Judged at each observation at which x occupies a carrier c (st.travel_region) whose entrance end is an intersection i (st.lane_enters c i) - x approaching i, the observation of its entry, where its footprint overlaps both c and i, included - and there is a vehicle y other than x that has entered i from a different highway: y's footprint overlaps i and has overlapped it continuously since an observation at which y occupied a carrier cy with st.lane_enters cy i, cy lying on a highway (st.on_way) that c does not lie on. A y is not counted (exception) where x and y approach from opposite directions (dot product of st.lane_direction of c and cy below minus p.opposed_approach_cos_tolerance) and x or y has a declared intention to turn left at i (int.turn_left) or is turning left within i (drv.motion.turning_left with p.yaw_rate_tolerance). Not applicable where i is controlled by an official traffic-control device: a traffic signal, stop sign or yield sign governs i or a carrier whose entrance end is i (dev.governs); this exception is suspended where NRS_484B_250_4_o1 or NRS_484B_250_4_o2 applies to x (an intersection whose signal is inoperative when x enters).
obligation: At a judged observation at which x's footprint overlaps i and x is moving (drv.motion.moving with p.motion_speed_tolerance), no vehicle y of the applicability (bound again with its whole selection and exception) has its centre and x's approach within p.conflict_time_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance).

narrowings.why: The driver is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
The official status of a signal or sign is read from its presence on the road.
Yielding is judged where x moves into or within the intersection; slowing on the approach before entry is not separately checked.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: No device governs i or its approaches. x approaches on lane c (st.lane_enters c i, on highway A); y entered i from lane cy on highway B and is crossing. x moves into i; predicted closest approach 1 m in 1.5 s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same, but x halts on c while y crosses i and enters only after y has left.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A dev.stop_sign governs c; the intersection is controlled by an official device and no signal is inoperative.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but st.lane_enters is not observed, so whether x approaches i and from which carrier y entered is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: x and y approach on opposed carriers (dot product of directions -1); y has int.turn_left at i and is turning left within i when x moves in: y is excepted and no other vehicle has entered i.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: i is governed by a dev.traffic_signal that is dev.inoperative at x's entry; the device exception is suspended; y crossing from highway B, conflict predicted when x moves in.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: x approaches and enters an uncontrolled intersection with no other road user in the scene.
